content.text:
Flyer built and rendered — no layout defects in any size.

- **Structure**: one full-bleed column stack (`fill`×`fill`, clipped) so headline, photo band, candidate row, red CTA bar, steps and footer all stretch edge-to-edge at every size.
- **Photo**: `flexGrow` band with `fit: cover` + focus point, so it crops (36–64% trimmed) instead of distorting.
- **Columns**: three `flexGrow: 1` cards with equal gaps stay evenly spaced; on the 300×600 skyscraper they stack vertically via a `media` override.
- **Sky adaptation**: per-size type/icon/padding bumps lift the smallest text from 6.2px to 10.6px physical.
